name: RunMailAutomation
description: Runs one mail automation (MailAutomations row) now, from the inbox automations tab or from RunDueAutomations. Today the only kind is the monthly open-debts mail: it calls the open-debts batch logic (PrepareOpenDebtsBatch) with the automation's audience (all customers with a debit balance, or customerCodes), subjectTemplate and bodyTemplate (variables {{customerName}}, {{customerCode}}, {{contactName}}, {{asOfDate}}, {{month}}, {{openTotal}}, {{bookkeeperName}}, {{bookkeeperPhone}}), and mailboxId. dryRun=true returns the eligible and excluded customers (with Hebrew reasons) and, when previewCustomerCode is given, the rendered subject, body and a preview PDF url for that customer, writing nothing. The PDFs list the open debts from OpenMovements; while that table is empty no draft is written and a scheduled run is recorded נכשלה (the hourly runner tries again). dryRun=false writes the drafts to the outbox (Approvals, component מנה חודשית, status ממתין; a re-run in the same month replaces that month's pending drafts), one MailAutomationRuns row (trigger, requestedBy, batchId, draftsCreated, excludedCount, excludedSummary, status, errors) and updates lastRunAt / lastRunSummary on the automation. subject/body overrides apply to this run only (used by the preview while editing). Sends nothing.

requestedBy.description: Display name of who pressed הרץ עכשיו

previewCustomerCode.description: Customer to render the preview for (dryRun)

subjectOverride.description: Template to use instead of the saved subject, this run only

bodyOverride.description: Template to use instead of the saved body, this run only

eligible.description: { customerCode, customerName, contactName, contactEmail, openTotal, bookkeeperName }

usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Previewing the monthly mail**: "הצגת התצוגה" in the automation card on the Inbox page (פניות → אוטומציות), after picking a sample customer
  Shows that customer's mail as it would be written — recipient, subject, body and the open-debts PDF — using the wording currently in the editor, even before it is saved, plus who would get the mail and who is left out and why. Nothing is written.
- **Checking a run before it happens**: "הרץ עכשיו" on the automation card
  Opens a window that first lists who would get the mail and who is left out, with the reason. Nothing is written yet.
- **Running it now**: "יצירת N טיוטות" in that window
  Creates the drafts in the outbox (one per customer), records the run in the history and shows a link to those drafts. Nothing is sent.
